paragraphs.en: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
paragraphs.zh: Google 产品与技术的智能体技能

paragraphs.en: This repository contains Agent Skills for Google products and technologies, including Google Cloud .
paragraphs.zh: 该代码库包含适用于 Google 产品与技术（包括 Google Cloud）的智能体技能（Agent Skills）。

paragraphs.en: npx skills add google/skills When prompted, select specific skills or all skills, the target agents to configure, and the installation scope (project or global).
paragraphs.zh: npx skills add google/skills 在提示出现时，选择具体的技能或全部技能、要配置的目标智能体，以及安装范围（项目或全局）。

paragraphs.en: If npx is not available in your environment, install Node.js , which includes npm and npx .
paragraphs.zh: 如果您的环境中没有 npx，请安装 Node.js，其中包含 npm 和 npx。

paragraphs.en: To update previously installed skills to the latest versions, run the following command.
paragraphs.zh: 若要将先前安装的技能更新到最新版本，请运行以下命令。

paragraphs.en: npx skills update This command gives you an option to also remove obsolete skills.
paragraphs.zh: npx skills update 此命令还会为你提供一个移除过时技能的选项。

paragraphs.en: This repo also bundles Google product plugins (Skills + MCP servers) for agent harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 本仓库还为智能体运行框架捆绑了 Google 产品插件（Skills + MCP 服务器）。

paragraphs.en: If you need help or encounter issues with these skills, search for existing issues or open a new one in the GitHub Issue Tracker .
paragraphs.zh: 如果您在使用这些技能时需要帮助或遇到问题，请在 GitHub Issue Tracker 中搜索已有的 issue 或提交新的 issue。
